solution.paragraph: $$\begin{array}{l} {{\int_{- \infty}^{0}\frac{x^{3}}{\left( {1 + x^{4}} \right)^{3 \slash 2}}dx}{= \lim\limits_{a\rightarrow - \infty}{\int_{a}^{0}{x^{3}{({1 + x^{4}})}^{- 3 \slash 2}dx}}}} \\ {\phantom{\int_{- \infty}^{0}\frac{x^{3}}{{({1 + x^{4}})}^{3 \slash 2}}dx}{= \left. \lim\limits_{a\rightarrow - \infty}\frac{1}{4}\left( {- 2} \right){({1 + x^{4}})}^{- 1 \slash 2} \right|_{a}^{0}} \begin{array}{l} {Integrate by} \\ {substitution.} \end{array}} \\ {\phantom{\int_{- \infty}^{0}\frac{x^{3}}{\left( {1 + x^{4}} \right)^{3 \slash 2}}dx}{= - \frac{1}{2}\lim\limits_{a\rightarrow - \infty}\left\lbrack {1 - \frac{1}{\left( {1 + a^{4}} \right)^{1 \slash 2}}} \right\rbrack}} \\ {\phantom{\int_{- \infty}^{0}\frac{x^{3}}{\left( {1 + x^{4}} \right)^{3 \slash 2}}dx}{= - \frac{1}{2}}} \end{array}$$
